rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload trip (X13 low) and assert motor overload alarm M191.
Reset latched cell fault M190 upon pressing fault reset pushbutton X1.
Aggregate latched fault, motor overload, and E-stop status into general fault M199.
Enable conveyor motor contactor Y10 in auto mode when no general fault is active.
Monitor pallet at stop position photo-eye X10 and set pallet-in-position flag M100.
Latch stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of line controller release request X14.
Time stopper release duration (2.0 s preset) while solenoid Y11 is energized.
Reset stopper release solenoid Y11 when duration timer T11 completes.
